title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure
description:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.   Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.   The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.  With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot. We are looking to add a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure to our team. You will own how Anchorage Digital positions and takes to market its stablecoin infrastructure: the platform institutions use to mint, redeem, bridge, custody, settle, and manage USD stablecoins through a federally chartered bank, plus the API and developer surface behind it and the payments service that lets banks move dollars onchain without a correspondent bank. Your buyers are the people who run money movement and treasury: payments and treasury leads at banks and fintechs, trading desks and exchanges that settle in stablecoins, and the engineers and product managers who integrate against our API. They care about speed, cost, counterparty risk, and regulatory standing, and they are comparing us to crypto-native infrastructure providers, bank consortia, and doing nothing. This is a generalist product marketing role on a small team. Product marketing is the core of the job, and you will also carry brand, events, and communications work for your product lines: the launch announcement, the developer content, the conference presence, the client reference program. You should be as comfortable writing a technical one-pager as briefing a designer or prepping an executive for a panel. We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure role:
  • Write the positioning, messaging, and ICP definition for stablecoin infrastructure, covering minting and redemption, settlement, treasury, bank payments, and the API, and keep them current as the products and the market move.
  • Build and maintain the sales toolkit: pitch decks, one-pagers, solution pages, competitive battlecards, FAQs, integration overviews, and client case studies, and train Sales on how to use them.
  • Run product launches end to end: new chains and stablecoins supported, new API capabilities, pricing changes, and new bank services, with the announcement, developer content, website and in-app updates, and enablement ready on day one.
  • Produce content for an institutional and technical audience, from web copy and blog posts to developer guides, white papers, webinars, and conference talks, in the Anchorage Digital voice.
  • Turn infrastructure concepts (settlement finality, reserve handling, bridging, treasury operations) into a clear business case for a treasurer, a payments lead, and an engineer, and decide which proof points each one needs.
  • Build competitive positioning against crypto-native infrastructure providers and bank consortia, and make the case for running money movement through a federally chartered bank in plain terms a buyer can repeat internally.
  • Own the brand, events, and communications calendar for your product lines, including developer and payments conference presence, speaking submissions, and executive prep.
  • Develop fluency in how our platform and API work, which stablecoins and chains we support, and the regulatory standing that shapes what we can say.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on roadmap priorities using client interviews, integration feedback, win and loss analysis, and market research.
  • Work with Legal and Compliance so every external claim survives review the first time.
  • Gather client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and share it across Marketing, Product, Sales, and the Stablecoin Solutions team.
  • Act as the marketing point of contact for the stablecoin infrastructure business, and bring the broader Marketing team (design, demand generation, social, communications) into your launches.
  • Have 5 or more years in B2B product marketing, with at least part of that marketing an API, platform, or infrastructure product in fintech, payments, financial services, or digital assets. 
  • Have owned positioning and go-to-market for a technical product end to end, from ICP and messaging through launch and sales enablement, and can show the results.
  • Write clearly for both a treasurer and an engineer, in short form and long form, and can explain settlement, minting and redemption, or a bridge between chains without a glossary.
  • Have worked on brand, events, or communications programs, not only product marketing, and are happy to carry those for your product lines on a small team.
  • Have sold alongside a sales team: built the deck, trained the reps, sat in on the calls, and changed the pitch based on what you heard.
  • Are comfortable with regulatory and compliance review, and treat it as part of getting the story right rather than an obstacle.
  • Search constantly for client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and use it to change what we build and say.
  • Have marketed payments infrastructure, a developer platform, or a settlement or treasury product.
  • Have worked with developer relations or produced developer-facing content such as integration guides and API overviews.
  • Have marketed to banks, and understand how a bank evaluates a new vendor for money movement.
  • Follow stablecoin settlement, bank adoption of onchain payments, and the GENIUS Act closely and have opinions about where the market goes next.
  • Were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system.

title: Paid Media Strategist
description:
About elk Marketing

elk Marketing is a fast-growing digital agency driving profitable, scalable results for eCommerce and B2B brands like Nutrabio, goodr, Trauma Services, and Built Bar. We’re outcome-obsessed and strategy-led, trusted by our clients to deliver real revenue growth, not just impressions and clicks.

About the Engagement

We’re looking for an experienced, strategic, and performance-driven independent contractor who can scale paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads while confidently supporting client relationships.

This is a part-time, remote contractor engagement for someone who can take ownership of campaign strategy, execution, reporting, and optimization while serving as a trusted advisor to clients. You’ll translate complex performance data into clear insights, identify growth opportunities, and guide clients toward stronger results.

  • Engagement type: Part-time independent contractor

  • Location: Canada (Remote)

  • Hours: Up to 20 hours per week, depending on client needs and agreed scope

  • Compensation: CAD $25–$45 per hour, depending on experience and expertise

As an independent contractor, you’ll take ownership of your assigned work and deliverables while collaborating with elk’s internal team to support client goals and campaign performance.

Our Culture

At elk, we value clarity, ownership, and curiosity. We trust experts to make smart decisions and take initiative in their work. We collaborate in Slack, stay accountable in Asana, and know how to have fun. From quarterly trivia competitions (with prizes from our awesome clients!) to continued learning, we make space to celebrate wins, laugh a little, and stay connected no matter where we’re working from. You’ll be surrounded by sharp marketers who value collaboration and innovation.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, manage, and scale campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.

  • Manage Google Ads campaign types, including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max (PMax), as well as Meta campaigns, including dynamic product ads (DPAs) and Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC+).

  • Develop and execute TikTok advertising strategies, including audience targeting, creative testing, and campaign optimization.

  • Build strategic roadmaps aligned with client business goals.

  • Audit and structure advertising accounts to improve return on ad spend (ROAS), acquisition efficiency, and profitability.

  • Write and test ad creative, including copy, hooks, headlines, and creative concepts.

  • Present campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to clients.

  • Collaborate with SEO, design, CRO, and email teams to align cross-channel strategies.

  • Manage advertising budgets ranging from $10K to $500K+ per month.

  • Identify optimization opportunities and proactively recommend strategies to improve campaign performance.

  • Stay current on emerging paid media platforms, features, and best practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience managing paid media campaigns, including hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.

  • Proven success scaling advertising accounts and independently managing campaign strategy, execution, and optimization across all three required platforms.

  • Strong understanding of Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns.

  • Experience with Meta campaign structures, dynamic product ads, and Advantage+ campaign types.

  • Experience developing, launching, and optimizing TikTok Ads campaigns, including creative testing and performance analysis.

  • Experience managing paid media for eCommerce brands and/or B2B businesses.

  • Familiarity with shopping feeds and product catalog advertising across Google and Meta.

  • Understanding of landing page conversion rate optimization (CRO) best practices and collaboration with development and design teams.

  • Strong client-facing communication skills and the ability to explain performance data and strategic recommendations clearly.

  • Solid understanding of attribution and reporting tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, and Looker Studio.

  • Experience with Shopify, Asana, Slack, and Google Workspace.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with connected TV (CTV), retail media (Walmart, Amazon Ads, and Amazon DSP), Microsoft Ads, or Pinterest Ads.

  • Expertise in tracking, pixel implementation, Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Conversions API (CAPI) setup and configuration.

  • Experience configuring and designing Looker Studio dashboards.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this engagement will be measured by the quality and effectiveness of campaign strategy and execution, proactive identification of growth opportunities, clear performance reporting, strong client communication, and measurable progress toward client business goals.

The contractor will collaborate with elk’s team to establish priorities, deliverables, and timelines based on the agreed scope of work and available hours.

Equal Opportunity

elk Marketing is committed to equal opportunity and a respectful, inclusive working environment. We value diverse perspectives and welcome qualified professionals from all backgrounds.

title: Paid Media Manager (Remote)
description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work. We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference. Today, we're looking for a Paid Media Manager to join our growing team. Our new Paid Media Manager will serve as a subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will play both the lead role & support on a portfolio of Paid Media client strategies, build & maintain great client relationships, manage timelines and deliverables, and directly grow clients’ marketing performance through your work.   The Paid Media Manager will independently lead account strategy for a select few of their own clients, while also working closely with Senior Paid Media Managers and Associate Directors to support on account strategy & tactical execution for larger clients as needed. This role is ideal for a Paid Media pro with 3+ years of experience who is driven and hungry to bring their media strategy & client ownership chops to the next level. You’ll work on a team of top-notch digital marketing SMEs, and will collaborate with counterparts on SEO, Measurement, and Creative teams to successfully execute client delivery.   Here’s what we expect from our Paid Media Manager.

  • Client Ownership: Responsible for the strategy development, innovation, and tactical execution + performance of small-but-impactful portfolio Paid Media client accounts. (3-5 clients)

  • Hitting Client Goals: Plan, implement and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs, marketing, and business goals

  • Hands-on-keys Execution: Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

  • Client-Facing / Account Management: Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships

  • Testing & Innovation: Support channel innovation efforts, ensuring clients' Paid Media strategies are following evolving best practices and using performance data to identify opportunities for new campaigns, optimizations, and testing

  • Reporting: Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

  • Project Management: Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

  • Creative Strategy: Collaborate with Silverback's Creative Director and Design team on ad creation and testing plans; assist with creative strategy and briefs as needed

  • Know Your Client's Business: Understand your clients’ industries, audience, and goals while staying on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

  • Teamwork & Collaboration: Join in creative brainstorming sessions with other members of the Paid Media team to promote a culture of collaboration and innovation

  • Professional Growth: Accept feedback and coaching from the Associate Director of Media to ensure our clients are receiving a best-in-class experience & top-notch performance.

  • Years of Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of paid media agency experience - ideal candidate has 3-5 YOE. Previous performance agency experience is a MUST-HAVE!

  • Paid Search and Social Expertise: Must-have experience managing both Paid Search and Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google & Meta; secondary platforms are LinkedIn and TikTok)

  • Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the Paid Media engagement with your assigned clients.

  • Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute winning Paid Media strategies across multiple industries is crucial — but your ability to tie Media wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, revenue, etc is what will make you a superstar.

  • Ownership of Work: In this role, you'll fully own the success of your 3-5 clients from strategy development, to tactical execution, to reporting & client-facing communication. You MUST have prior experience taking "full ownership" of client(s) in a similar vein in order to succeed at Silverback.

  • Curiosity & “Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. You’re relentlessly curious, eager to learn, and willing to make mistakes in the name of progress & growth.

  • Data Analysis: You're a whiz in Excel and/or Google Sheets. Complex sets of data don't throw you, and you're comfortable analyzing & breaking down data using GA4 and other tools to produce clear, insightful, and meaningful reports for clients.

  • Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.

  • Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don't throw you. 

    • Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

    • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

    • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

    • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

    • Unlimited PTO

    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

    • Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

    • Company-paid ClassPass membership

    • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

    • Summer Fridays

    • 401(k) with Employer Match

    • We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.

    • We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.

    • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you!
